children: Overview
U.S. lingerie retailer's Q2 net sales rose 10%, slightly missing analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q2 beat analyst expectations
Company raised full-year 2026 net sales and adjusted operating income guidance
Outlook
Victoria's Secret raises 2026 net sales forecast to $7.1 bln-$7.18 bln from $7.03 bln-$7.13 bln
Company lifts 2026 adjusted operating income outlook to $560 mln-$590 mln from $550 mln-$580 mln
Victoria's Secret expects Q3 net sales of $1.57 bln-$1.6 bln and operating income of $10 mln-$20 mln
Result Drivers
REGULAR-PRICE SELLING - Co said stronger regular-price selling contributed to improved results
MARKETING INVESTMENTS - Co said increased strategic marketing investment is expanding reach and deepening customer connection
INTERNATIONAL GROWTH - Co reported international sales rose 20% year-over-year in Q2
